orgsyn_cv1p0018.cite: Organic Syntheses, Adipic acid: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.18 (1941); Vol. 5, p.9 (1925)
orgsyn_cv1p0018.says: Cyclohexanol (5 mol) is oxidised with 50% nitric acid and 1 g ammonium vanadate (catalyst) to adipic acid.

orgsyn_cv1p0087.cite: Organic Syntheses, Benzil: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.87 (1941); Vol. 6, p.6 (1926)
orgsyn_cv1p0087.says: Benzoin is oxidised to benzil with copper sulfate in aqueous pyridine, the copper being reoxidised by air.

orgsyn_cv1p0089.cite: Organic Syntheses, Benzilic acid: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.89 (1941); Vol. 1, p.29 (1921)
orgsyn_cv1p0089.says: Benzoin is converted directly by NaOH/NaBrO3 (benzil formed in situ, then benzilic acid rearrangement) and acidified to benzilic acid; benzohydrol is a removed by-product.

orgsyn_cv1p0107.cite: Organic Syntheses, Benzyl cyanide: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.107 (1941); Vol. 2, p.9 (1922)
orgsyn_cv1p0107.says: Benzyl chloride with sodium cyanide in aqueous alcohol, 4 h reflux, gives benzyl cyanide.

orgsyn_cv1p0170.cite: Organic Syntheses, o- and p-Chlorotoluene: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.170 (1941); Vol. 3, p.33 (1923)
orgsyn_cv1p0170.says: o-Toluidine hydrochloride is diazotised with NaNO2 and the diazonium solution is added to a cuprous chloride solution to give o-chlorotoluene.

orgsyn_cv1p0199.cite: Organic Syntheses, Diacetone alcohol: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.199 (1941); Vol. 1, p.45 (1921)
orgsyn_cv1p0199.says: Acetone is condensed over barium hydroxide in a Soxhlet extractor (95-120 h) to diacetone alcohol.

orgsyn_cv1p0235.cite: Organic Syntheses, Ethyl acetoacetate: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.235 (1941); Vol. 6, p.36 (1926)
orgsyn_cv1p0235.says: Ethyl acetate with sodium (giving sodium ethoxide) undergoes Claisen condensation; acidification with acetic acid gives ethyl acetoacetate.

orgsyn_cv1p0345.cite: Organic Syntheses, Mesityl oxide: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.345 (1941); Vol. 1, p.53 (1921)
orgsyn_cv1p0345.says: Diacetone alcohol is distilled with a trace of iodine to give mesityl oxide.

orgsyn_cv1p0436.cite: Organic Syntheses, Phenylacetic acid: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.436 (1941); Vol. 2, p.63 (1922)
orgsyn_cv1p0436.says: Benzyl cyanide is hydrolysed with aqueous sulfuric acid (3 h reflux) to phenylacetic acid.

orgsyn_cv1p0459.cite: Organic Syntheses, Pinacol hydrate: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.459 (1941); Vol. 5, p.87 (1925)
orgsyn_cv1p0459.says: Magnesium and mercuric chloride in acetone/benzene give magnesium pinacolate, hydrolysed to pinacol hydrate.

orgsyn_cv1p0462.cite: Organic Syntheses, Pinacolone: Org. Synth. Coll. Vol. 1, p.462 (1941); Vol. 5, p.91 (1925)
orgsyn_cv1p0462.says: Pinacol hydrate is distilled with 6 N sulfuric acid to give pinacolone.

wiki_aspirin.says: Salicylic acid is treated with acetic anhydride (small amount of sulfuric/phosphoric acid catalyst) to give aspirin and acetic acid.

wiki_adipic.says: Adipic acid with barium hydroxide at elevated temperature undergoes ketonization to cyclopentanone.

wiki_cyclopentanone.says: Ketonic decarboxylation of adipic acid gives cyclopentanone, at elevated temperature with barium hydroxide.

wiki_paracetamol.says: Classical route: nitration of phenol gives 4-nitrophenol, reduced to 4-aminophenol by hydrogenation over Raney nickel, then acetylated with acetic anhydride.

wiki_phenacetin.says: Phenacetin is made by Williamson ether synthesis: ethyl iodide, paracetamol and anhydrous K2CO3 in 2-butanone.

wiki_nitroaniline.says: Laboratory synthesis from aniline: acetyl protection is required before nitration because protonated aniline is meta-directing; some 2-nitroaniline also forms.

wiki_acetanilide.says: Acetanilide is produced by reacting acetic anhydride with aniline.

wiki_lidocaine.says: Lidocaine may be synthesised from 2,6-xylidine and chloroacetyl chloride (the page text gives only this; the scheme is an image).

wiki_mibk.says: At laboratory scale MIBK is made in three steps from acetone: aldol to diacetone alcohol, dehydration to mesityl oxide, then hydrogenation.

wiki_dimedone.says: Dimedone is prepared from mesityl oxide and diethyl malonate via a Michael addition.

wiki_aeester.says: Ethyl acetoacetate is deprotonated, alkylated at the alpha carbon, then hydrolysed and decarboxylated with heat/aqueous acid to a methyl ketone.

wiki_grignard.says: Organic halide plus magnesium gives the Grignard reagent, which adds to aldehydes and ketones to give alcohols.

wiki_protgroup.says: Figure caption: ethylene glycol protects a ketone as an acetal during an ester reduction, versus unprotected reduction to a diol.

wiki_sandmeyer.says: Aryl diazonium salts are converted to aryl chlorides with CuCl.

orgsyn_cv1p0008.cite: Organic Syntheses, p-Acetaminobenzenesulfonyl chloride, Coll. Vol. 1, p.8
orgsyn_cv1p0008.says: Acetanilide plus excess chlorosulfonic acid (60 C, 2 h) gives 4-acetamidobenzenesulfonyl chloride (known only from a search-result excerpt; direct fetch was blocked with HTTP 403).

orgsyn_cv2p0200.cite: Organic Syntheses, Dimedone (methone), Coll. Vol. 2, p.200
orgsyn_cv2p0200.says: Dimedone from sodium ethoxide, diethyl malonate and mesityl oxide then KOH hydrolysis and acidification (known only from a search-result excerpt; direct fetch was blocked with HTTP 403).

orgsyn_cv1p0248_cv1p0351.cite: Organic Syntheses, ethyl n-butylacetoacetate (Coll. Vol. 1, p.248) and methyl n-amyl ketone (Coll. Vol. 1, p.351)
orgsyn_cv1p0248_cv1p0351.says: Ethyl acetoacetate is alkylated with n-butyl bromide, then ketonic hydrolysis gives 2-heptanone (known only from search-result excerpts; direct fetch was blocked with HTTP 403).

cases.notes: Avoid list: mesityl oxide (dehydration, over-reaction). Target MW 116.2.
